# An abandoned self service session is a churn sig

> An abandoned self-service session is a churn signal, not a saved ticket.


## The heuristic

**An abandoned self-service session is a churn signal, not a saved ticket.**


_Why:_ The customer had a problem, tried, failed, and stopped asking us. They did not stop having the problem — they lowered their expectation of us. Read against account health this is one of the earliest quiet churn indicators support ever gets, and the deflection dashboard is actively concealing it.
